name: requirement-hover
displayName: Requirement Hover: hover, highlight and go to requirement definitions (RF, RN, RNF...)
description: Hover, highlight and go to requirement definitions (RF, RN, RNF, FR, NFR, UC, US, BR) across your workspace.
author: Lucas Bueno

rfHover.prefixes.markdownDescription: Extra requirement prefixes, added on top of the defaults (`RF`, `RN`, `RNF`, `FR`, `NFR`, `UC`, `US`, `BR`). A definition must be a single line in the format `PREFIX-number: text`, for example `RF-01: the system must...`.

rfHover.disabledPrefixes.markdownDescription: Default prefixes to turn off, for example `["BR", "US"]`.

rfHover.language.markdownDescription: Language of the hover link and tip. `auto` follows the editor display language.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/requirements.test.js out/test/i18n.test.js out/test/hover.test.js
